independent_test_audit.limitation_statement: All 35,520 valid binary outcome judgments in Jud-IPL were exhausted during the initial Phase 18 split (24,849 train, 5,320 val, 5,351 test). The remaining 6,486 documents in Jud-IPL comprise 6,485 cases with label 'Other' (remands, interlocutory orders, advisory references) and 1 blank record, none of which possess ground-truth binary outcome labels. Per Strict Constraint 5 ('Never fabricate metrics or labels') and Phase 19G guidance ('If insufficient unused documents exist, report this limitation and do not claim a new independent test result'), no synthetic or unverified test results are generated.
